seo.title: Craftsmanship Knowledge | openIndu Community Forum
seo.description: An industrial craftsmanship knowledge base covering display panels, semiconductors, new energy, automotive electronics and high-end equipment: end-to-end process chains, shop-floor practice and defect reasoning, shared on the openIndu forum.

hero.title: Craftsmanship Knowledge Base
hero.subtitle: End-to-end process chains across five industries: display panels, semiconductors, new energy, automotive electronics and high-end equipment
hero.tagline: Engineers share what really happens on the floor → the industry improves together → better yield, lower cost

panel.name: Display Panel Processes
panel.description: Two chains, TFT-LCD and OLED: substrate → array/backplane → colour filter/evaporation → cell → module

semiconductor.name: Semiconductor Processes
semiconductor.description: Wafer fabrication → wafer test → assembly & packaging → final test and traceability

newEnergy.name: New-Energy Processes
newEnergy.description: Lithium: slurry → electrode → cell → formation & grading → PACK. PV: cell → module → EL/IV

automotive.name: Automotive Electronics Processes
automotive.description: PCBA → controller assembly → firmware flashing → end-of-line inspection

equipment.name: High-End Equipment Processes
equipment.description: Industrial robots: components → assembly → calibration → FAT → delivery
